topics: Concept of static and dynamic balancing
Analysis of effect of unbalanced masses in single and multiple planes in rotating elements
Approaches and equipment for measurement of unbalanced masses

units.title: Dynamics of Reciprocating Engines
topics: Single Cylinder Engine: Slider – Crank kinematics (Analytical)
static and dynamic equivalence of models (for masses)
Inline Engines: Effect of phase angles
firing order and number of strokes
inertia torques and determination best configuration / unbalanced mass

units.title: Introduction to Mechanical Vibrations

damped natural frequency and logarithmic decay
Analytical solution of Forced vibrations with harmonic excitation system and vector representation
Phase difference and Transmissibility on frequency of 10 20% excitation for various damping factors
Two Degrees of Freedom System: Equation of motion and principal mode of vibration
torsional vibrations of two and three rotor system
geared system. 5 10% Multi degree freedom systems and analysis (Free vibrations): Concepts of normal mode vibrations
Correct definition of natural frequency. 4 5% Vibrations of Continuous Systems (Free Vibrations): Longitudinal vibrations of bar or rod: Equation of motion and solution
Lateral vibrations of beam: Equation of motion
solution. 4 10% Rotating unbalance: Whirling of shafts
Critical speed and its practical importance in the design of shafts
Application of Dunkerley’s method and Rayleigh’s method for estimating the critical speed of shafts
Vibration Measurement: Introduction to vibration measurement and analysis devices: Vibrometer
